components.name: Gift Opening Button
components.description: The rose-gradient primary action that opens the celebration.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; min-height:54px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:11px; padding:14px 22px; border:0; border-radius:2px; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(110deg,var(--rose-800),var(--rose-600)); box-shadow:0 13px 28px rgba(146,54,82,.22); font:600 12px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro','Segoe UI',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.035em; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease,transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button svg { width:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--rose-950); box-shadow:0 15px 34px rgba(109,40,64,.29); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:hover svg { transform:translateY(4px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--champagne); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99); }

components.name: Quiet Text Link
components.description: A restrained, underlined invitation with a small directional cue.
components.html: Send a little love
components.css: .ds-text-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:0 0 4px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(165,72,98,.5); color:var(--rose-800); font:600 12px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro','Segoe UI',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color .25s ease,border-color .25s ease; } .ds-text-link svg { width:17px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-text-link:hover { color:var(--rose-950); border-color:var(--rose-950); } .ds-text-link:hover svg { transform:translateY(4px); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--champagne); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Keepsake Navigation
components.description: A compact floating navigation strip that stays secondary to the greeting.
components.html: Warm wishesOur flowersDraw a wish
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:clamp(18px,3vw,44px); min-height:66px; padding:8px 19px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.66); border-radius:3px; background:rgba(255,251,246,.84); box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(94,41,60,.08); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); } .ds-nav a { color:var(--ink-soft); font:400 13px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro','Segoe UI',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:.25em; transition:color .2s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--rose-800); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--champagne); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Paper Letter
components.description: The shared note presented as the page's central keepsake surface.
components.html:
✿

A note for you

Thank you for bringing warmth, energy, and so many smiles to our office.

Happy 20.10!
components.css: .ds-letter { position:relative; width:min(100%,790px); padding:clamp(50px,7vw,91px) clamp(25px,8vw,96px); border:1px solid rgba(201,161,112,.47); background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.94),rgba(255,249,241,.86)),var(--paper); box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(109,54,71,.12),0 5px 18px rgba(109,54,71,.08); color:var(--ink); text-align:center; } .ds-letter::before { position:absolute; inset:13px; border:1px solid rgba(189,146,83,.25); content:''; pointer-events:none; } .ds-letter__seal { display:grid; width:54px; height:54px; margin:0 auto 18px; place-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(189,146,83,.5); border-radius:50%; color:var(--rose-700); } .ds-letter h2 { margin:0; color:var(--rose-950); font:500 clamp(36px,5.1vw,70px)/.96 'Cormorant Garamond','Times New Roman',serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-letter p { max-width:56ch; margin:28px auto 20px; color:var(--ink-soft); font:400 14px/1.95 'Be Vietnam Pro','Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-letter strong { color:var(--rose-800); font:600 24px/1.3 'Cormorant Garamond','Times New Roman',serif; }

components.name: Polaroid Keepsake
components.description: A slightly rotated snapshot that straightens and lifts when engaged.
components.css: .ds-polaroid { width:190px; padding:8px 8px 14px; background:#fffdf9; box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(76,44,51,.13); transform:rotate(-4deg); transition:box-shadow .3s ease,transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-polaroid__photo { aspect-ratio:4/5; background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--rose-200),var(--cream)); } .ds-polaroid figcaption { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:12px 4px 0; color:var(--ink); font:600 22px/1.1 'Cormorant Garamond','Times New Roman',serif; } .ds-polaroid figcaption span { color:var(--rose-700); font:14px/1 'Be Vietnam Pro','Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-polaroid:hover,.ds-polaroid:focus-within { box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(76,44,51,.19); transform:rotate(0) translateY(-5px); }

narrative.overview:
This is a warm, romantic, quietly celebratory visual world: a personal paper keepsake, illuminated in rose and cream, that opens into a celebration of the real women in this office. Cormorant lettering brings a soft editorial voice; clear Vietnamese body copy and generous space keep the experience welcoming rather than ornate.

The composition uses folded-paper cues, fine champagne lines, and authentic portraits to make the page feel handmade for its recipients. Animation adds a brief sense of occasion, while the underlying surfaces stay calm and legible. It explicitly avoids generic greeting-card templates and cluttered effects.
keyCharacteristics: Rose-lit paper, blush, cream, and champagne details.
Real office portraits lead; decorative framing supports them.
Elegant display type paired with clear Vietnamese copy.
Soft ambient depth and restrained, purposeful motion.

rules.name: The Champagne-Line Rule
rules.body: Gold is a fine accent for seams, seals, and small details—not a large competing field.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the expressive serif for occasion and identity; use the sans-serif for information, controls, and Vietnamese reading copy.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces receive ambient depth; stronger lift belongs to interaction states.

dos: Do use Rosewater Pink (`#a54862`) as a deliberate accent against light paper.
Do reserve Champagne Gold (`#bd9253`) for thin seams, rules, and small ornaments.
Do let the supplied portraits and names lead the story.
Do preserve the serif/sans pairing and readable Vietnamese text.
Do keep motion purposeful, lightweight, and responsive to reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep opening actions, focus states, and mobile touch targets clear.
donts: Don't use generic greeting-card templates or clutter decorative effects.
Don't let decoration compete with the people being celebrated.
Don't turn champagne gold into a large, high-contrast surface.
Don't make important information depend on hover, sound, or animation.
Don't use heavy shadows or rounded pill shapes as the default form language.
